description: Complete NEW warning-field selection: real native13RP grant; visible caster commits literal20ft-range Fireball5RP; warning then real paid5RP Counterspell/check17vs16 negates it before any damage draw. Rank0 later warning demonstrates no rank cap without granting sight of hidden E.

originalScenarioCompleteUnchanged.originalTextUnchanged: DI6-06-A: During an active field, a visible enemy within actual Counterspell range commits a fire spell aimed into the readable sphere. The caster receives its readable identity, rank, local footprint and save/damage procedure before the normal counter window, but no future die result. If the caster already has a legal Reaction and source access, they may pay for an ordinary Counterspell; the Prophecy itself grants no extra attempt or free movement.
